facts.fact: The World Bank's results table records 0 municipal land bureaux equipped and operational with access to the Land Information System at 21 November 2025, against a target of 120 by September 2026, in the project's 138 municipalities.
facts.system: Municipal Land Bureaus equipped and operational with LIS access

facts.fact: The World Bank's supervision mission of 10-25 November 2025 recommends immediate workarounds for electricity and Internet connections at the municipal land offices, to give a minimum level of service for SIFCOM; land office construction was under way in 128 of 138 municipalities, about 75% complete.

The World Bank reports that SIFCOM, the land information system the municipal land offices are to work in, was not yet deployed at November 2025: its modules were mainly validated and deployment was postponed to end-December 2025.

The project that is to equip municipal land bureaux with Land Information System access is financed by two World Bank IDA instruments of 40.00 each (38.43 and 38.11 revised), 84.94% and 78.58% disbursed, closing 24 July 2026; no domestic line is stated.

facts.fact: The indicator for municipal land bureaux equipped and operational with LIS access stood at 0 on both 31 May 2025 and 21 November 2025, and SIFCOM's deployment was postponed to end-December 2025.
